description: Solve the Kelvin equilibrium of every MOSAIC size bin of every grid cell (mosaic_kelvin_equilibrium.esm, Kelvin.aw on lev x bin): elementwise, the scalar root of Kelvin's constraint 0 ~ aw0/K(aw) - aw for the bin water activity Kelvin.aw, by Newton with a backtracking line search, starting from aw0 = rh 0.01 (the document's initialization equation). converged.residual 1e-13 matches the tolerance at which the EqWeFiC root tests (aerosol_phase_state.esm kelvin_root_*) were generated. The Fortran instead iterates aw <- aw0/K(aw) to a relative update of 1e-2 (1e-6 above 99% RH), at most ten updates, and stops 0.2% (median) to 1% from this root (data/eqwefic/notes/mosaic_mesa_kelvin_solvers.md). On the MESA branch the water comes from mosaic_mesa_equilibrium.esm and this solve would nest that one; that assembly is not written yet.
